headline: IGL shares decline 29% YTD as brokerages cut targets despite maintaining positive ratings
hook: Margin pressure hits Indraprastha Gas shares
summary: Indraprastha Gas has seen its shares fall 29% year-to-date following the release of its Q2 FY27 financial results. Despite facing margin pressure during the quarter, select brokerages have chosen to retain their positive ratings on the stock. However, these brokerages have simultaneously lowered their target prices to reflect the ongoing earnings headwinds. Indian retail investors holding the stock must weigh the lowered price targets against the continued analyst confidence.
why_it_matters: Lowered broker targets signal reduced near-term upside for IGL holders

headline: Indraprastha Gas shares fall 10% to 52-week low after weak Q2 results
hook: IGL net profit plunges 93.5% in Q2
summary: Indraprastha Gas Limited reported a 93.5% year-on-year decline in standalone net profit to ₹24.38 crore for the second quarter. Following the earnings release, the company's stock crashed 10% to hit a fresh 52-week low. The sharp drop in profitability reflects severe margin contraction for the city gas distributor. Retail investors in IGL face immediate losses as the stock hits its lowest level in a year.

headline: IGL shares drop nearly 10 percent after Q2 profit falls sharply
hook: Operating profit swings to a loss
summary: Indraprastha Gas reported a steep 89 percent fall in net profit and an EBITDA swing to a loss for the second quarter, triggering a nearly 10 percent plunge in its share price. Total sales volumes averaged 10.06 million standard cubic metres per day, slightly above CNBC-TV18 poll estimates of 10 mmscmd. Volumes rose 3 percent sequentially and 7 percent year-on-year. Indian retail investors holding city gas distribution stocks face margin pressures amid weaker financial performance.
